description: Implementation of a manager for handling product image files in a CMS using Infinispan cache. The class supports adding, retrieving, and removing product images, managing image sizes, and interacting with cache nodes in a tree structure.

classes.name: CmsImageFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Manages product images in a CMS using Infinispan cache, supporting CRUD operations and cache node interactions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the manager instance.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a product image to the cache structure.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image based on product details.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves list of images for a product or merchant store.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images for a specific product.

methods.name: getProductImage (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific sized image for a product.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Fetches or creates a cache node for a given path.
